title: BlocksListParams
description: Params of the blocks.list agent tool: list the finished command blocks of a session — what the person has actually run and can see — newest first, each with the id blocks.read takes, the command, how it ended and how many lines it printed. A finished command's rows leave the terminal grid at the block freeze (the renderer's clearViewport: the grid only ever holds the running command's rows), so readScreen sees nothing of them and this is the tool that does. The blocks the tool may list are bounded by the grant's session scopes, enforced by the narrowed capability (ADR-0028 decision 4): a block outside them is not listed, not filtered afterwards. The window contract of the return (design §4.4) — the total, the window returned, and whether more remain — is the tool's return contract, not a parameter. The model is untrusted input and gets the same check the renderer's parameters get: additionalProperties false plus an explicit required list.

sessionId.description: The session whose blocks are listed, inside the grant's session scopes.

limit.description: How many blocks to list, newest first. Absent: 10. The reply says whether older blocks remain.
